senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; v. צָנַן) a bottle of glossy material. Mekh. B’shall., Vayassʿa, s. 5; Tanḥ.
units: B’shall. 21 (ref. to Ex. XVI, 33) איני יודע … ת״ל צ׳ … דבר המציץ וכ׳ I should not have known of what material it was, whether of silver …, therefore the text has tsintseneth, something that glistens more than anything else, that is, a (glazed) earthen vessel.

<cite ref="Exodus 16:33">Ib.</cite> <he>צ׳ המן</he> the bottle of manna (which was preserved), v. <cite ref="R00493"><he>צְלוֹחִית</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Noah 18 <he>צ׳ מלאה וכ׳</he> a bottle full of live locusts.
